title: 第2章 拜顾长青为我大秦上卿！位同九卿！总领灭六国之一切事宜！
slug: 先秦炼气两千年世人误闯天家

第(1/3)页

“我所走的路，是真实存在的。一条，凡人无法理解的通天大道！”

嬴政胸膛剧烈地起伏着，他看着顾长青，眼神中充满了震撼、狂热和前所未有的渴望。

他挥了挥手，对左右道：“都退下！”

“大王！”

李斯急忙出声，想要劝谏。

“退下！”

嬴政的声音不容置疑。

李斯等人心头一凛，不敢再多言，只能躬身告退。

很快，偌大的宫殿，只剩下嬴政和顾长青两人。

嬴政走下王座，一步步来到顾长青面前，他第一次如此近距离地打量着这个年轻人。

“你想要什么？”

嬴政开门见山地问道。

他相信，这样的人，绝不会无欲无求。

顾长青迎着他的目光，说出了一句让嬴政意想不到的话。

“我不要金钱，不要权位。”

“我想要的，是助大王，扫平六合，一统天下！”

嬴政愣住了。

他设想过无数种可能。

顾长青或许会要数不尽的黄金，或许会要一块封地，甚至可能会向他讨要某种特权。

但他万万没想到，顾长青的回答，竟然是帮他一统天下。

“帮寡人一统天下？”

嬴政的眼神变得锐利起来，他重新审视着眼前的年轻人，“你一个方外之人，也懂军国大事？”

在他看来，修仙问道，应该是避世隐居，不问凡尘。

顾长青的言行，完全颠覆了他的认知。

“略懂一二。”

顾长青神色自若，“大王志在扫平六国，开创万世未有之基业。此等雄心，旷古烁今。但六国并立，根深蒂固，若无万全之策，纵有虎狼之师，恐亦要耗费日久，伤亡惨重。”

嬴政沉默了。

"The path I am taking is real. A road to the sky that no mortal can understand!"

Ying Zheng's chest heaved violently. He looked at Gu Changqing, his eyes full of shock, enthusiasm and unprecedented desire.

He waved his hand and said to the left and right: "Everyone, step back!"

"Your Majesty!"

Li Si hurriedly spoke out, wanting to dissuade him.

"Back off!"

Ying Zheng’s voice was unmistakable.

Li Si and others were shocked and did not dare to say anything more, so they could only bow and leave.

Soon, only Ying Zheng and Gu Changqing were left in the huge palace.

Ying Zheng stepped down from the throne and came to Gu Changqing step by step. It was the first time that he looked at the young man so closely.

"What do you want?"

Ying Zheng asked straight to the point.

He believed that such a person would never have no desires or desires.

Gu Changqing met his gaze and said something that Ying Zheng didn't expect.

"I don't want money or power."

"What I want is to help the king, wipe out Liuhe, and unify the world!"

Ying Zheng was stunned.

He imagined countless possibilities.

Gu Changqing may ask for countless gold, a fief, or even some kind of privilege.

But he never expected that Gu Changqing's answer would actually help him dominate the world.

"Help the few to rule the world?"

Ying Zheng's eyes became sharp, and he looked at the young man in front of him again, "You are an outsider, but you also understand military and national affairs?"

In his opinion, cultivating immortals and asking questions should be about living in seclusion and not caring about the mortal world.

Gu Changqing's words and deeds completely subverted his cognition.

"Know a thing or two."

Gu Changqing looked calm, "Your Majesty is determined to conquer the six countries and create a foundation that has never been seen in the world. Such ambitions are from ancient times to the present. However, the six countries stand side by side and are deeply rooted. If there is no perfect strategy, even if there is a tiger and wolf army, it will probably take a long time and suffer heavy casualties."

Ying Zheng was silent.
